result.instructions: Tools for GoCanvas, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which inspection forms were submitted this week, and by whom?"; "Show me the answers of the latest completed safety checklist."; "List my field users and the departments they belong to.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GoCanvas data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gocanvas_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gocanvas_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gocanvas_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. gocanvas_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gocanvas_get_me
tools.title: Get the connected GoCanvas user
tools.description: The user who owns the connected OAuth application: id, login, company id and name, default department and role. Use it to learn the default department id.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_forms
tools.title: List GoCanvas forms
tools.description: Forms (mobile form definitions) the connected user can see: id, name, status, version, department. Paged, 100 per page. Use gocanvas_get_form for a form's fields (entries).

assigned.description: true = only the user's assigned, active forms (only has an effect for users who can manage forms).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_get_form
tools.title: Get a GoCanvas form definition
tools.description: One form definition, including its screens and entries (field ids and labels). Use format 'flat' for the simplest list of fields (what you need to read submissions or create a dispatch), 'nested' (default) for the full structure, 'metadata' or 'minimal' for less.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_form_reports
tools.title: List report definitions of a GoCanvas form
tools.description: The report (PDF) definitions attached to a form: id, name, format, whether emailed by default. Paged.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

annotations.title: List report definitions of a GoCanvas form

tools.name: gocanvas_list_submissions
tools.title: List GoCanvas submissions
tools.description: Completed forms (submissions): id, form, number, created time, department, user, status. At least one of form_id, user_id or user_email is required (user_id and user_email cannot be combined). Default status is completed. Dates filter created_at. Paged, 100 per page. Use gocanvas_get_submission for the answers.

form_id.description: Form id; matches every version of the form.

user_id.description: The user who created the submission.

user_email.description: Email (login) of the user who created the submission; not with user_id.

department_id.description: Department id (default: the user's default department).

status.description: Status filter (default completed). handed-off needs hand_off; custom needs custom_status.

hand_off.description: Workflow handoff state name; required for status handed-off.

custom_status.description: Custom status label; required for status custom.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_get_submission
tools.title: Get a GoCanvas submission
tools.description: One submission with all its responses (entry id, label, type, value). Accepts the numeric submission id or the client GUID.

submission_id.description: Numeric submission id (e.g. 691911) or client GUID (e.g. 02ED5FB2-9C61-4F18-AB17-543547DF899B).

tools.name: gocanvas_list_submission_revisions
tools.title: List revisions of a GoCanvas submission
tools.description: The revision history of a submission (who changed it and when). Paged.

submission_id.description: Numeric submission id or client GUID.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

annotations.title: List revisions of a GoCanvas submission

tools.name: gocanvas_list_users
tools.title: List GoCanvas users
tools.description: Users of the company: id, name, email, enabled. Paged, 100 per page.

enabled.description: true = only enabled users, false = only disabled (default: both).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_get_user
tools.title: Get a GoCanvas user
tools.description: One user by id: name, login, contact data, default department and role.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_departments
tools.title: List GoCanvas departments
tools.description: Departments of the company: id, name, description. The pseudo department -1 'All' is included.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_department_users
tools.title: List users of a GoCanvas department
tools.description: The users in one department with their department role.

annotations.title: List users of a GoCanvas department

tools.name: gocanvas_list_dispatches
tools.title: List GoCanvas dispatches
tools.description: Dispatches (jobs sent to field workers): id, form, assignee, status, schedule. At least one of user_id, department_id or form_id is required. Dates are ISO-8601. Paged.

user_id.description: The user the dispatch is assigned to.

project_id.description: Only dispatches assigned to this project.

status.description: unassigned, assigned, received or ready (ready ignores the date filters and is scoped to the connected user).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_get_dispatch
tools.title: Get a GoCanvas dispatch
tools.description: One dispatch by id with its pre-filled responses, schedule and status.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_customers
tools.title: List GoCanvas customers
tools.description: Customers (contacts of the Project Management view): individuals or businesses, optionally tied to a site. Paged.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_projects
tools.title: List GoCanvas projects
tools.description: Projects of the Project Management view. Paged.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_sites
tools.title: List GoCanvas sites
tools.description: Sites (job locations) of the Project Management view. Paged.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_reference_data
tools.title: List GoCanvas reference data sets
tools.description: Reference data (lookup tables used by forms): id, name, columns, version. Without department_id the user's default department is used.

assigned.description: true = only reference data used by forms assigned to the user.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_get_reference_data
tools.title: Get a GoCanvas reference data set
tools.description: One reference data set with its rows.

annotations.title: Get a GoCanvas reference data set

tools.name: gocanvas_list_groups
tools.title: List GoCanvas groups
tools.description: User groups: id, name, and the forms and users assigned. Paged.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_workflows
tools.title: List GoCanvas workflows
tools.description: Workflows (handoff chains between users) the connected user takes part in, with their handoff states and the count of tasks available to claim. Paged.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_list_locations
tools.title: List GoCanvas tracker locations
tools.description: GPS location events of field users (needs the tracker feature). start_date and end_date are required and may span at most 7 days. Omit user_id for all users of the company. Paged.

start_date.description: Start of the window (ISO-8601; a bare date means 00:00:00).

end_date.description: End of the window (ISO-8601; a bare date means 23:59:59). At most 7 days after start_date.

use_created_at.description: true = filter by upload time (created_at) instead of recorded_at.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply. 100 results per page.

tools.name: gocanvas_create_dispatch
tools.title: Create a GoCanvas dispatch
tools.description: WRITE: creates a dispatch, a job that appears on the assignee's mobile device (immediate_dispatch is sent at once, with a push notification when send_notification is true; scheduled_dispatch needs scheduled_at and scheduled_end). Responses pre-fill the assignee's form (entry ids from gocanvas_get_form). Without assignee_id the dispatch stays unassigned. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two dispatches. Media fields cannot be pre-filled.

dispatch_type.description: immediate_dispatch is sent now; scheduled_dispatch at scheduled_at.

assignee_id.description: The user who gets the dispatch (from gocanvas_list_users); omit to leave it unassigned.

name.description: Short name shown on the dispatch calendar.

description.description: Description shown on the assignee's device.

department_id.description: Department; default is the user's default department.

value.description: The value to pre-fill, as text.

multi_key.description: Only for looped forms: reference to the looped value (one key per loop row).

send_notification.description: Immediate dispatches: send a push notification to the mobile app.

scheduled_at.description: Scheduled dispatches: start, in the format MM/DD/YYYY h:mm:ss AM, e.g. 12/1/2024 8:00:00 AM.

reminder_interval.description: Scheduled dispatches: minutes before the start to send a reminder.

send_calendar_invite.description: Scheduled dispatches: send a calendar invite.

tools.name: gocanvas_mark_dispatch_received
tools.title: Mark a GoCanvas dispatch as received
tools.description: WRITE: acknowledges a dispatch (status becomes received). Only works for a dispatch in the assigned state that is assigned to the connected user; repeating it is refused by GoCanvas.

annotations.title: Mark a GoCanvas dispatch as received
